5. provide all appropriate protection from the Sub-Contract Works and associated plant and machinery and all appropriate signage for members of the public using any public highway adjoining or adjacent to the Site; and

children: In consideration of the Contractor (at the request of the Guarantor) entering into the Sub-Contract, the Guarantor by this Deed irrevocably and unconditionally guarantees to the Contractor as surety the full and due performance of all the obligations of the Sub-Contractor contained within the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: As a separate and independent obligation and liability from its obligations and liabilities under clause 1 the Guarantor shall indemnify the Contractor against (and shall on first written demand pay to the Contractor without any deduction or set-off, the amount of) all sums, losses, debts, damages, interests, costs and expenses (including, without limitation, legal costs and expenses incurred in enforcing the provisions of the Sub-Contract or this Deed) which may be incurred by the Contractor by reason of any failure, default or breach on the part of the Sub-Contractor in the discharge of any of the Sub-Contractor's obligations under or pursuant to the Sub-Contract (including, without limitation, all such sums, losses, debts, damages, interests, costs and expenses which may be incurred by reason of the non-payment to the Contractor of any debts due from the Sub-Contractor to the Contractor under or pursuant to the Sub-Contract, whether such non-payment is or is not consequent upon the Sub-Contractor being Insolvent (as defined in the Sub-Contract).

children.name: text
children: If the Sub-Contractor's employment under the Sub-Contract is terminated or if the Sub-Contractor is Insolvent (as defined in the Sub-Contract) in accordance with the Sub-Contract, the Guarantor shall indemnify the Contractor against (and shall on first written demand pay to the Contractor without any deduction or set-off, the amount of) all sums, losses, debts, damages, interests, costs and expenses (including, without limitation, legal costs and expenses incurred in enforcing the provisions of the Sub-Contract or this Deed) which may be incurred by the Contractor by reason of the Sub-Contractor's termination or being Insolvent (as defined in the Sub-Contract).

children.name: text
children: The liability of the Guarantor will not be discharged or affected in any way by:

children.name: text
children: any act, matter or thing whatsoever, or any rule of law, which, but for this clause 3, might operate to release in whole or in part the Guarantor from its obligations under this Deed including (without limitation) any novation, assignment or termination of the Sub-Contract or of the Sub-Contractor's employment thereunder (whether automatic or otherwise and whether by reason of the Sub-Contractor's insolvency or otherwise), or any amendment or extension of time or variation of or under the Sub-Contract or any forbearance or forgiveness by the Contractor, or any change in the extent or nature of the Sub-Contract Works; or

children.name: text
children: any total or partial invalidity, illegality or unenforceability of the Sub-Contract; or

children.name: text
children: any legal limitation, disability or incapacity of the Sub-Contractor; or

children.name: text
children: any act, matter or thing whatsoever, except an express release by Deed by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: This Deed creates a continuing guarantee and will remain in force until all the obligations of the Sub-Contractor under the Sub-Contract have been fully satisfied.

children.name: text
children: The Guarantor waives any right it may have of first requiring the Contractor to proceed against or enforce any claims against any of the parties to the Sub-Contract or any other person.

children.name: text
children: As long as any liability incurred by the Sub-Contractor to the Contractor guaranteed under this Deed remains unsatisfied, the Guarantor shall not, in respect of any payment made or liability arising under this Deed, effect (or try to effect) any recovery from the Sub-Contractor, whether by receipt of money, set-off, proof of debt, enforcement of security or otherwise.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor is entitled to assign the benefit of and its rights under this Deed (as a whole only and not in parts) at any time without the Guarantor's consent.

children.name: text
children: The parties to this Deed do not intend that any of its terms will be enforceable by virtue of the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 by any person not a party to it.

children.name: text

children: {b:{u:THIS PERFORMANCE BOND}} is made as a deed {b:{u:BETWEEN}} the following parties whose names and addresses are set out in the Schedule to this Bond (the "Schedule"):

children.name: text
children: By a sub-contract (the "Sub-Contract") entered into or to be entered into between the Contractor and the Sub-Contractor, particulars of which are set out in the Schedule the Sub-Contractor has agreed with the Contractor to execute works (the "Works") upon and subject to the terms and conditions therein set out.

children.name: text
children: The Guarantor has agreed with the Contractor at the request of the Sub-Contractor to guarantee the performance of the obligations of the Sub-Contractor under the Sub-Contract upon the terms and conditions of this Performance Bond subject to the limitation set out in clause 2.

children.name: text
children: The Guarantor irrevocably guarantees to the Contractor that in the event of a breach of the Sub-Contract by the Sub-Contractor or in the event that the Sub-Contractor is insolvent as defined by clause 7.1 of the Sub-Contract and /or the employment of the Sub-Contractor is determined by reason of any one or more of the events set out in clauses 7.1, 7.4, 7.5, 7.6 and/or 7.9A of the Sub-Contract the Guarantor shall subject to the provisions of this Performance Bond satisfy and discharge the losses and damages sustained by the Contractor as established and ascertained pursuant to and in accordance with the provisions of or by reference to the Sub-Contract and taking in to account all sums due or to become due to the Sub-Contractor or as agreed between the Contractor, the Guarantor and the Sub-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The maximum aggregate liability of the Guarantor and the Sub-Contractor under this Performance Bond shall not exceed the sum set out in the Schedule (the "Bond Amount") but subject to such limitation and to clause 4 the liability of the Guarantor shall be co-extensive with the liability of the Sub-Contractor under the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: The liability of the Guarantor under this Performance Bond shall not in any way be discharged released reduced or affected by:

children.name: text
children: any amendment, modification, waiver, consent or variation, express or implied, to the scope of the Main Contract Works or to the Sub-Contract or any related documentation;

children.name: text
children: the granting of any extensions of time or forbearance, forgiveness or indulgences in relation to time to the Sub-Contractor;

children.name: text
children: the enforcement, absence of enforcement of the Sub-Contract or of any security, right of action or other guarantee or indemnity;

children.name: text
children: the liquidation, administration or dissolution of the Sub-Contractor or disclaimer by liquidation; or

children.name: text
children: the illegality, invalidity or unenforceability of or any defect in any one provision of the Sub-Contract or any of the Obligations in respect of the remaining provisions of the Sub-Contract or Obligations;

children.name: text
children: any indulgence or additional or advanced payment, forbearance, payment or concession to the Sub-Contractor;

children.name: text
children: any compromise of any dispute with the Sub-Contractor;

children.name: text
children: any failure of supervision to detect or prevent any fault of the Sub-Contractor; and/or

children.name: text
children: any assignment of the benefit of the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: Whether or not this Performance Bond shall be returned to the Guarantor the obligations of the Guarantor under this Performance Bond shall be released and discharged absolutely upon the Expiry Date (as defined in the Schedule) save in respect of any breach of the Sub-Contract which has occurred and in respect of which a claim in writing containing particulars of such breach has been made upon the Guarantor before the Expiry Date.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor having requested the execution of this Performance Bond by the Guarantor undertakes to the Guarantor (without limitation of any other rights and remedies of the Contractor or the Guarantor against the Sub-Contractor) to perform and discharge the obligations on its part set out in the Sub-Contract.
